(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from a __reinforced__ open rib structure; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said __reinforced__ open rib structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first __reinforced__ open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second __reinforced__ open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first __reinforced__ open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second __reinforced__ open rib structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa and is __selected to optimize performance__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with __a sufficient percentage of__ long glass fibers __to enhance strength__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3.5 mm __to meet performance criteria__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2.5 mm __to ensure adequate structural integrity__.
